missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Изменение' is a neuter '-ние' noun in the nominative as the predicate. 'Важное' is the agreeing neuter adjective marking the case and gender.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Изменение' is neuter and inanimate, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'заметили'. 'Небольшое' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Изменения' is the genitive after 'нет', stating no change in the plan. 'Никакого' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Изменению' takes the dative after 'к', expressing preparation for the change. 'Готовятся' describes the collective readiness.
Strategic focus: Instrumental complement. 'Изменением' takes the instrumental after 'довольны', which governs that case. 'Этим' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Изменении' takes the prepositional after 'в', placing the meaning within the change. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Изменения' takes the genitive after 'из-за', giving the cause. 'Планы сорвались' states the consequence of the change.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Изменения' is the nominative plural subject of 'начались'. 'Большие' agrees in the plural, and 'в стране' sets the place.
Strategic focus: Dative plural complement. 'Изменениям' takes the dative plural after 'рады', which governs that case. 'Последним' agrees in the dative plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after preposition. 'Изменений' is the genitive plural after 'после', placing the improvement in time. 'Всё стало лучше' states the outcome.
